- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended neighborhoods to stay in Paris include:

  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Le Marais (3rd and 4th arrondissements): A trendy area with boutiques, art galleries, and a vibrant LGBTQ+ scene.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Montmartre (9th and 18th arrondissements): A historic neighborhood with a bohemian vibe, street artists, and stunning views of the city.
